name: Breaking Up
overview: Scripture reminds believers that God’s ways are perfect and His word trustworthy, offering protection and guidance to those who trust in Him (Psalms 18:30). In times of brokenness, such as after a difficult separation, the Lord draws near to the contrite in heart, providing comfort and salvation (Psalms 34:18). God’s plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope for a future, encouraging believers to rely on His faithful promises even amid personal trials (Jeremiah 29:11). Obedience to God's commandments brings blessing and exaltation, underscoring the importance of trusting His design for restoration and healing (Deuteronomy 28:1).
